content.text:
Here are good places to order a birthday cake online in the U.S., depending on what you need:

**Best nationwide delivery**
- **Goldbelly** — cakes from famous bakeries shipped nationwide; good for specialty or “wow” cakes. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/cakes?utm_source=openai))
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — focused on birthday cake delivery and gift-style cakes. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Carlo’s Bakery** — nationwide shipping plus local pickup where available. ([carlosbakery.com](https://carlosbakery.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Best for local pickup/delivery**
- **Cakes.com** — connects you with local bakeries for personalized cake ordering, with pickup or delivery where available. ([cakes.com](https://www.cakes.com/?locale=en&utm_source=openai))
- **Edible Arrangements** — birthday cakes and bundles from local Edible stores; some locations offer quick delivery or pickup. ([ediblearrangements.com](https://www.ediblearrangements.com/birthday-cakes?utm_source=openai))
- **Grocery store bakeries** — Kroger/Ralphs, Safeway, Walmart, Publix, Whole Foods, etc. Many let you customize cakes online for pickup or delivery.

**Best for ice cream cakes**
- **Baskin-Robbins** — online cake ordering for custom ice cream cakes, usually for local pickup.

**Fastest option**
- Try **DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart, or your local grocery store app** and search “birthday cake.” This is usually best for same-day delivery.

If you tell me your **city/ZIP code**, the **date you need it**, and whether you want **delivery or pickup**, I can suggest the best nearby options.
